children: Bhatt brings over two decades of experience across HR business partnering, talent management, hiring, workforce planning and leadership development

HDFC Life has elevated Anupriya Bhatt to Associate Vice President – Human Resources, expanding her leadership responsibilities across HR business partnering, talent and capability development, employee engagement and workforce planning.

Bhatt brings more than 20 years of experience across financial services, technology and other sectors. She has spent over nine years with HDFC Life, where she has held roles covering corporate talent acquisition, senior leadership hiring, HR business partnering and talent management.
Bhatt took up the Associate Vice President role in April 2026. Her current responsibilities include HR business partnering, talent and capability, employee engagement, retention and HR strategy.

She has also worked closely with business leaders on people priorities, including talent pipelines, performance management, workforce planning and leadership development. Her experience covers both strategic HR initiatives and operational people management.

Before her elevation, Bhatt served as Chief Manager Human Resources at HDFC Life from August 2017. In that role, she handled corporate talent acquisition and senior leadership hiring while leading the HR business partnership function for operations and shared services.

Her responsibilities also included campus recruitment and leadership succession initiatives. She has worked across talent acquisition, capability building, employee engagement and performance management during her tenure with the organisation.
Before joining HDFC Life, Bhatt spent more than five years with Exide Life Insurance, where she held the positions of Deputy General Manager Human Resources and Senior Manager Human Resources.

Earlier, she worked with Indiabulls as Regional Manager Human Resources and Regional Human Resources Manager. Her responsibilities included organisation development, talent acquisition, performance management, HR operations, policy formulation and compliance support across South India.

Bhatt began her career in recruitment and HR operations, including roles at IBM and IBM India. At IBM, she worked as Recruitment Manager for functions spanning global marketing, finance, business transformation, technology and HR.

Her earlier experience also includes roles at HMV Saregama India and Descon. Across these positions, her experience has covered executive search, graduate recruitment, technical recruiting, HR consulting and HR policies.

Bhatt holds a postgraduate diploma in business management with a specialisation in human resources management from M.S. Ramaiah Institute of Management. She also holds a diploma in Labour and Administrative Law from Annamalai University.
